call_summary: Customer was interested but concerned about pricing. Agent demonstrated value and secured agreement for a pilot.
missed_opportunity: Could have provided a customer success story.
success_failure_reason: Customer understood the value compared to the cost.
recommended_improvement: Use more customer success examples when discussing ROI.

call_summary: Customer initially lacked trust in the solution. Agent provided references and built credibility.
missed_opportunity: Could have shared a case study earlier in the conversation.
success_failure_reason: Trust concerns were successfully addressed.
recommended_improvement: Present social proof earlier in similar conversations.

call_summary: Customer was highly price sensitive but agreed after discussing long-term savings.
missed_opportunity: Agent could have quantified savings more precisely.
success_failure_reason: Customer became convinced of the financial value.
recommended_improvement: Provide clearer ROI calculations.

call_summary: Customer quickly saw value in the solution and agreed to proceed.
missed_opportunity: No major missed opportunity.
success_failure_reason: Strong product fit and effective closing.
recommended_improvement: Continue using discovery-based selling.

call_summary: Customer liked the product but was busy with another strategic initiative.
missed_opportunity: Agent failed to secure a follow-up meeting.
success_failure_reason: Timing prevented immediate purchase.
recommended_improvement: Always define a concrete next step before ending the call.

call_summary: Customer hesitated due to cost but agreed after discussion of business benefits.
missed_opportunity: Could have used a stronger ROI example.
success_failure_reason: Value proposition outweighed pricing concerns.
recommended_improvement: Use measurable business outcomes during negotiations.

call_summary: Customer had concerns about reliability and implementation. Agent successfully built confidence.
missed_opportunity: Could have addressed implementation concerns earlier.
success_failure_reason: Trust was established through examples and references.
recommended_improvement: Introduce implementation success stories earlier.

call_summary: Customer required additional information before committing and agreed after clarification.
missed_opportunity: Agent could have anticipated common questions.
success_failure_reason: Customer received sufficient information to make a decision.
recommended_improvement: Prepare FAQ-based responses for common concerns.

call_summary: Customer focused heavily on price and rejected the offer.
missed_opportunity: Agent did not sufficiently justify the value.
success_failure_reason: Customer perceived the solution as too expensive.
recommended_improvement: Strengthen value-based objection handling.

call_summary: Customer was satisfied with a competitor solution and saw little reason to switch.
missed_opportunity: Agent did not explore weaknesses in the competitor product.
success_failure_reason: Customer remained committed to the existing solution.
recommended_improvement: Use discovery questions to uncover dissatisfaction with competitors.

call_summary: Customer immediately recognized the value of automated reporting and agreed to move forward.
missed_opportunity: Could have discussed long-term expansion opportunities.
success_failure_reason: Strong alignment between customer needs and product capabilities.
recommended_improvement: Continue using business-focused discovery questions.

call_summary: Customer hesitated due to budget constraints but accepted after reviewing expected savings.
missed_opportunity: Agent could have quantified cost savings more precisely.
success_failure_reason: Customer became convinced of the financial benefits.
recommended_improvement: Prepare ROI examples for budget-sensitive customers.

call_summary: Customer liked the solution but was unable to commit during an active internal project.
missed_opportunity: Agent failed to schedule a future discussion.
success_failure_reason: Customer postponed the decision due to competing priorities.
recommended_improvement: Always secure a follow-up date.

call_summary: Customer felt the solution did not address their current business needs.
missed_opportunity: Agent did not sufficiently qualify the customer early in the call.
success_failure_reason: Poor product fit prevented progress.
recommended_improvement: Improve qualification before presenting the solution.

call_summary: Customer already used a competing analytics platform and saw little reason to switch.
missed_opportunity: Agent failed to differentiate the product effectively.
success_failure_reason: Customer remained loyal to the existing vendor.
recommended_improvement: Focus on unique differentiators during competitor discussions.

call_summary: Customer initially questioned vendor reliability but became confident after references were provided.
missed_opportunity: Could have addressed trust concerns sooner.
success_failure_reason: Trust was established and the customer agreed to proceed.
recommended_improvement: Introduce references earlier in the sales process.

call_summary: Customer focused primarily on price and did not perceive enough value.
missed_opportunity: Agent did not effectively connect benefits to business outcomes.
success_failure_reason: Pricing concerns remained unresolved.
recommended_improvement: Improve value-based selling techniques.

call_summary: Customer stated that the solution was not relevant to current operations.
missed_opportunity: Agent continued pitching despite weak fit.
success_failure_reason: Customer never saw a compelling use case.
recommended_improvement: Improve customer qualification and discovery.

call_summary: Customer showed interest but declined after discussing costs.
missed_opportunity: Agent did not successfully justify the investment.
success_failure_reason: Customer viewed the price as too high.
recommended_improvement: Use stronger ROI and business impact examples.

call_summary: Customer requested additional information and delayed the decision due to budget concerns.
missed_opportunity: Agent provided information but did not secure commitment.
success_failure_reason: Customer remained uncertain about value and pricing.
recommended_improvement: Combine information sharing with stronger closing techniques.
